raw_content:
id: vuln-spring-security-samples-4e3bec90
languages: [java]
severity: ERROR
message: "Spring Security vulnerable configuration detected."
metadata:
  cve: CVE-2023-34035
  cwe: CWE-863
pattern: >
  class: SecurityConfiguration
  method: securityFilterChain
  arguments: [HttpSecurity]
  body: >
    authorizeHttpRequests: >
      requestMatchers: >
        requestMatchers: ["/login", "/resources/**"]
        permitAll:
      anyRequest:
        authenticated:
    jee:
      mappableRoles: ["USER", "ADMIN"]

pattern-not: >
  class: SecurityConfiguration
  method: securityFilterChain
  arguments: [HttpSecurity, MvcRequestMatcher.Builder]
  body: >
    authorizeHttpRequests: >
      requestMatchers: >
        requestMatchers: ["/login", "/resources/**"]
        permitAll:
      anyRequest:
        authenticated:
    jee:
      mappableRoles: ["USER", "ADMIN"]
